body: Built cmd/norn, the first of S141-04's three remaining pieces (nornd daemon, CLI, Back Office panel). Three read-only subcommands: golden, history, status — never writes to a registry, the migration CLIs stay the only writers. -kind defaults to the registry filename per the one-kind-per-file convention every real instantiation already follows. Live-verified against both real production registries in PRRJECT_FATBABY/var/norn/ (eps_extractor, entity_graph_rules) — status/golden/history all round-tripped the real recorded data correctly. Unit test + a real-binary integration test. go build/vet/test -race clean across the whole workspace. nornd daemon and Back Office panel remain not started, disclosed not papered over. Commit 9d2f5c7.
title: S141-04 (partial): norn CLI — read-only golden/history/status over NDJSON registries
